parameters.content:
## AI for Social Good · Collect & Analyze
Runs daily at 09:00 (Asia/Singapore) or on **Execute workflow**.

1. **Config** holds every query and the LLM switch. Edit it to change what is collected.
2. Three sources are fetched in parallel: GitHub repositories, arXiv papers, Google News.
3. **Dedupe & Classify** merges them, removes duplicates and tags each item with an impact domain, SDGs and region using keyword rules.
4. Everything is upserted into the `projects` table of the `ai4sg` database.
5. If the LLM is enabled, relevant new items are re-classified by the LLM and upserted again.

Dashboard: open the **AI4SG · Dashboard** workflow, or visit http://localhost:5678/webhook/ai4sg

// Pack all items into one JSON payload so a single SQL statement can upsert them
const rows = $input.all().map(({ json: it }) => ({
  id: it.id,
  source: it.source,
  source_id: it.source_id,
  title: (it.title || '').slice(0, 500),
  url: it.url,
  description: (it.description || '').slice(0, 5000),
  owner: it.owner,
  published_at: it.published_at,
  stars: it.stars,
  language: it.language,
  topics: it.topics || [],
  project_type: it.project_type,
  domain: it.domain,
  sdgs: it.sdgs || [],
  region: it.region,
  org_type: it.org_type,
  summary: it.summary,
  relevance: it.relevance,
  is_relevant: !!it.is_relevant,
  analyzed_by: it.analyzed_by || 'rules',
}));
const bySource = rows.reduce((m, r) => ((m[r.source] = (m[r.source] || 0) + 1), m), {});
return [{
  json: {
    rows: JSON.stringify(rows),
    count: rows.length,
    new_items: $input.all().filter((i) => i.json.is_new).length,
    relevant: rows.filter((r) => r.is_relevant).length,
    llm_planned: $input.all().filter((i) => i.json.needs_llm).length,
    per_source: JSON.stringify(bySource),
  },
}];

INSERT INTO projects AS p (id, source, source_id, title, url, description, owner, published_at, stars, language,
                           topics, project_type, domain, sdgs, region, org_type, summary, relevance, is_relevant, analyzed_by)
SELECT id, source, source_id, title, url, description, owner, published_at, stars, language,
       coalesce(topics, '[]'), project_type, domain, coalesce(sdgs, '[]'), region, org_type, summary, relevance,
       coalesce(is_relevant, false), coalesce(analyzed_by, 'rules')
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS r(
    id text, source text, source_id text, title text, url text, description text, owner text,
    published_at timestamptz, stars int, language text, topics jsonb, project_type text, domain text,
    sdgs jsonb, region text, org_type text, summary text, relevance real, is_relevant boolean, analyzed_by text)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
    title       = EXCLUDED.title,
    url         = EXCLUDED.url,
    description = EXCLUDED.description,
    stars       = EXCLUDED.stars,
    topics      = EXCLUDED.topics,
    last_seen   = now(),
    -- an LLM classification is never overwritten by a later keyword classification
    domain      = CASE WHEN p.analyzed_by = 'llm' AND EXCLUDED.analyzed_by = 'rules' THEN p.domain      ELSE EXCLUDED.domain      END,
    sdgs        = CASE WHEN p.analyzed_by = 'llm' AND EXCLUDED.analyzed_by = 'rules' THEN p.sdgs        ELSE EXCLUDED.sdgs        END,
    region      = CASE WHEN p.analyzed_by = 'llm' AND EXCLUDED.analyzed_by = 'rules' THEN p.region      ELSE EXCLUDED.region      END,
    org_type    = CASE WHEN p.analyzed_by = 'llm' AND EXCLUDED.analyzed_by = 'rules' THEN p.org_type    ELSE EXCLUDED.org_type    END,
    summary     = CASE WHEN p.analyzed_by = 'llm' AND EXCLUDED.analyzed_by = 'rules' THEN p.summary     ELSE EXCLUDED.summary     END,
    relevance   = CASE WHEN p.analyzed_by = 'llm' AND EXCLUDED.analyzed_by = 'rules' THEN p.relevance   ELSE EXCLUDED.relevance   END,
    is_relevant = CASE WHEN p.analyzed_by = 'llm' AND EXCLUDED.analyzed_by = 'rules' THEN p.is_relevant ELSE EXCLUDED.is_relevant END,
    analyzed_by = CASE WHEN p.analyzed_by = 'llm' THEN 'llm' ELSE EXCLUDED.analyzed_by END;
INSERT INTO collection_runs (fetched, new_items, relevant, llm_analyzed, per_source) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::jsonb)
